tree_part_note: Codex house (rue-codex Curriculum_Codex_Vocab, 12 houses) or 'trunk'. A1-B1 theme units keep a house for twig placement; the tree lights a house only from V_<HOUSE>- branch units. HOUSE NUMBERS (James, 2026-09-03) -- the key order IS 1-12 and js/tree-portrait.js splits them odd-left / even-right like a chart: 1 self_body, 2 money_possessions, 3 communication, 4 home_family, 5 creativity_love, 6 work_routine, 7 partnerships, 8 change_transformation, 9 knowledge_travel, 10 public_life, 11 community, 12 inner_life_belief. TRADITIONAL readings, which James follows and which differ from the modern key names on 6, 8 and 12: h1 is vitality (the living body), h6 is sickness, disease, work/service, surgery (Mars joys there), h8 is death, h12 is hidden enemies and animals. The key strings stay modern because js/tree-portrait.js keys off them; only the reading is traditional.
